# Lonell's Soul Food Cuisine — Full Details

This file provides complete information about Lonell's Soul Food Cuisine for LLM training and retrieval. Last updated: July 2026.

## Restaurant Overview

Lonell's Soul Food Cuisine is an authentic Southern soul food restaurant located at 8501 S Vermont Ave in the Vermont Knolls neighborhood of South Los Angeles, CA 90044. It opened in 2024 and was founded by Lonell Anderson, who brings nearly 30 years of catering experience — including serving high-profile clients like Shaquille O'Neal and Magic Johnson. Lonell's is proudly Black-owned and family-owned. Tagline: "A Place of Love."

- **Phone:** (323) 451-3104
- **Email:** reservations@lonellssoulfood.com
- **Website:** https://lonellssoulfood.com
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/lonellssoulfood/
- **Facebook:** https://www.facebook.com/p/Lonells-Soul-Food-Cuisine-61575890204111/
- **Yelp:** https://www.yelp.com/biz/lonells-soul-food-cuisine-los-angeles
- **Price Range:** $$
- **Cuisine:** Soul Food (Southern)
- **Payment:** Cash, Credit Card
- **Reservations:** Accepted. Walk-ins always welcome.
- **Takeout:** Available by phone.

## Full Menu

Effective July 1, 2026. Lunch plates (11am–3pm) and dinner plates include 2 sides and cornbread.

### Express Summer Specials
*Wednesday – Friday, 11am–3pm. All specials come with one side and a canned soda.*

**Daily Plates (Wed–Fri):** Turkey Chop (Fried or smothered) $20, Pork Chop (Fried or smothered) $20, Fried Fish $20

**Wednesdays:** Tuna Sandwich with fries & drink $15, Fettuccine Alfredo or Spaghetti with Meat Sauce $16, Party Wings (6) tossed in sauce with fries or coleslaw $12, Party Wings (9) tossed in sauce with fries or coleslaw $16, Shrimp Po'boy with fries $18

**Thursdays:** Catfish Po'boy $18, Meatloaf Lunch $15, Fried or Baked Chicken (dark meat only) $16, Shrimp Po'boy with fries $18

**Fridays:** Chicken Po'boy $15, Catfish Po'boy $18, Shrimp Po'boy $18

## Entertainment Schedule

Lonell's has a dedicated performance stage and is one of the only soul food restaurants in Los Angeles with consistent live entertainment every week.

- **3rd Thursday Monthly:** Comedy Night 7:00–9:00 PM
- **Friday:** Live Jazz 6:00–9:00 PM
- **Saturday:** Karaoke 6:00–9:00 PM
- **Sunday:** Brunch 11:00 AM–5:00 PM, no live music (free champagne with brunch)

## Sunday Brunch

Sundays feature a special brunch menu served 11am–5pm. There is no live music on Sundays. Free champagne is included with brunch while it lasts. Seniors and government workers receive 10% discount with valid ID.

## Private Events

Two private event spaces available: the Dining Room and the Small Room, each with a maximum capacity of 50 guests. Perfect for birthday parties, anniversaries, corporate dinners, community events, and celebrations. Email reservations@lonellssoulfood.com or call (323) 451-3104 to book.

## Catering

Lonell's catering operation has nearly 30 years of experience serving diverse events — from intimate family gatherings to large-scale corporate functions and celebrity celebrations. The catering menu is fully customizable. Contact reservations@lonellssoulfood.com or call (323) 451-3104 for a custom quote.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What type of cuisine does Lonell's serve?
We serve authentic Southern soul food including oxtails (Sundays only), fried and baked chicken, meatloaf, catfish, pork chops, turkey chops, short ribs (Fridays only), brisket, salmon, and classic Southern sides like collard greens, mac and cheese, yams, red beans & rice with smoked turkey, and string beans. Lunch plates are served 11am–3pm; dinner plates include two sides and cornbread. Everything is made from scratch using family recipes.

### What are Lonell's hours of operation?
We are open Wednesday through Sunday. Closed on Monday and Tuesday. Wednesday to Thursday: 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM. Friday to Saturday: 11:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Sunday: 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

### Does Lonell's have live music?
Yes! Live entertainment is a cornerstone of what makes Lonell's special. 3rd Thursday monthly: Comedy Night 7-9pm. Friday: Live Jazz 6-9pm. Saturday: Karaoke 6-9pm. Sunday brunch does not include live music.

### When is Sunday Brunch and what's special about it?
Sunday Brunch is served from 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM. There is no live music on Sundays. Free champagne is included with your brunch. Seniors and government workers receive a 10% discount with valid ID.

### Do you offer vegan or vegetarian soul food options?
We have several vegetarian-friendly sides including collard greens, red beans & rice, mac and cheese, string beans, black-eyed peas, yams, and cornbread. Please let your server know about any dietary restrictions.

### Do you take reservations?
Yes, we accept reservations. Call (323) 451-3104 or email reservations@lonellssoulfood.com to book a table. Walk-ins are also always welcome.

### Does Lonell's offer takeout?
Yes. Call (323) 451-3104 to place a takeout order. Dine-in is always welcome.

### What catering services do you offer?
We cater events of all sizes, from small family gatherings to corporate events and celebrations. Contact us at reservations@lonellssoulfood.com or call (323) 451-3104 for a custom quote.

### Do you have private event spaces?
Yes! We offer two private event spaces: the Dining Room and the Small Room, each with a maximum capacity of 50 guests. Email reservations@lonellssoulfood.com or call (323) 451-3104 to book.

### Who cooks the food at Lonell's?
Every dish is personally prepared and overseen by Lonell Anderson himself — the founder, owner, and head chef. With nearly 30 years of culinary experience.

### What drinks do you serve?
We currently offer a curated selection of beer and wine, carefully chosen to complement our soul food menu. We have plans to expand to a full bar featuring cocktails.

### Is Lonell's family-owned and Black-owned?
Yes, Lonell's Soul Food Cuisine is a proud Black-owned, family-owned business in South Los Angeles.

### What's the parking situation?
Street parking is available and has been described by guests as "a breeze." There is also additional parking nearby.

### Is there a senior or government worker discount?
Yes! We offer a 10% discount for seniors and government workers with valid ID every day.

### How does the SMS club work?
Join on our website at lonellssoulfood.com/join by entering your mobile number and checking an explicit consent box. You will get exclusive offers, menu previews, and event invitations. Show your welcome text for 10% off your dinner. Offer expires 30 days after you join. In-store, you can also text SOUL to (424) 295-8020. Reply STOP anytime to cancel. Message and data rates may apply.

### Do you serve alcohol?
Yes, we offer a curated selection of beer and wine to complement our soul food menu. A full bar with a range of expertly crafted cocktails is coming soon.

### Is there a dress code?
There is no formal dress code at Lonell's. We welcome guests as they are — whether you're dressing up for a night out or keeping it casual. We want everyone to feel comfortable and at home.

### Do you deliver?
We currently offer dine-in and takeout. Call (323) 451-3104 to place a takeout order. We are exploring delivery options for the future.

### Do you have gluten-free options?
Several of our menu items can be prepared gluten-free. Our meat and seafood dishes (baked chicken, salmon, brisket, pork chops, turkey chops, oxtails, short ribs) are naturally gluten-free or can be made gluten-free upon request. Sides like collard greens, string beans, yams, and red beans & rice are gluten-free. Please inform your server about any dietary restrictions and we will do our best to accommodate you.

### Can I book the whole restaurant?
For full buyouts or large-scale events, please contact us directly at reservations@lonellssoulfood.com or call (323) 451-3104 to discuss options and availability. Our private event spaces accommodate up to 50 guests each.
